title: Jodis Lore
summary: Jodis Lore was a Seeker who controlled an Amulet of Metagolem. He hid the Amulet in Prague, Czech Republic, in the Golem's Attic behind an enchanted door.

sections.heading: History
sections.wikitext:
Jodis Lore magically enchanted the [[Golem's Attic]] on the [[Road of Alchemists]] so that only his [[Jodis Lore's Key|key]] would be able to open it. {{source|The Casterwill Client}} He then hid the key in his secret room below [[Prague Central Cemetery]]. {{source|Words of Truth, Heart of Lies}} He also left a set of notes documenting his exploration of the lost [[Tomb of Nefertiti]]. {{source|All Work and No Pay}}

Jodis Lore's notes on the [[Metagolem|golem]] were once found by [[Eathon Lambert]] and were then documented in his [[Eathon's journal|journal]]. His son, [[Lok Lambert]], later found these notes in the journal and provided Jodis Lore's information to the [[Huntik Foundation]] {{source|The Casterwill Client}}
